input: Write a test plan for the Acme Widget inventory tracker stock-adjustment endpoint.
expected: Test plan for POST /widgets/{id}/adjust: verify a positive delta increases stock_count, a negative delta decreases stock_count and rejects when it would go below zero, an unknown barcode id returns 404, and the low-stock alert fires when stock_count crosses the low_stock_threshold.
reference_actual: Test plan for POST /widgets/{id}/adjust: verify a positive delta increases stock_count, a negative delta decreases stock_count and rejects when it would go below zero, an unknown barcode id returns 404, and the low-stock alert fires when stock_count crosses the low_stock_threshold.
